$comment: Every prometheus launch merges this via lib/launch.sh: voltus-besstie is disabled for the session so one plugin's hooks, skills and agents load (removed at cutover); the workspace's own .mcp.json servers are pre-approved so no session opens on the MCP approval dialog, which Herdr reports as idle and the dispatcher would type into. The state dir ({state_dir}, filled by launch.sh) is an additional directory for every role: briefs, event details and reports live there. pr-review-toolkit is enabled here because a tab started in a project worktree does not load the workspace's own project settings.
